title: Supply Chain Trainee New
description:
Job Description

Nutreco Global Supply Chain Young Professional Program

Help achieve our purpose: Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a pioneer in animal nutrition and aquafeed – and our purpose of Feeding the Future is our passion. Through it, we’re shaping a sustainable future for food production globally. As part of the SHV family, our business lines, Skretting and Trouw Nutrition , are revolutionising aquaculture and advancing livestock health and productivity with innovative solutions that are breaking new ground in the industry. There’s no better place to kickstart your career!

The opportunity

he SC YPP is designed to build well-rounded supply chain professionals who can thrive in a global business environment. You will work closely with our global supply chain leadership teams and business units and contribute to real projects that drive efficiency and innovation.

Drive your future success in end-to-end supply chain by learning from some of the industry’s foremost experts in sustainability, procurement, quality, manufacturing, logistics, planning and engineering. In 18 months, you will gain hands-on experience and rotate through different Nutreco locations.

Through structured academy weeks, mentorship, and international exposure, you will develop skills needed to take on future roles within our supply chain

What we’re looking for:

Professional experience and passion: You have completed a master’s degree and have a genuine interest in end-to-end supply chain, with the analytical and problem-solving skills to thrive in a dynamic, international environment.

Language : Good proficiency of business English and local language

Global mobility and adaptability: Must be fully internationally mobile and ready for two global rotations. Candidates must hold permanent residency with a home country passport; visa sponsorship is not available.

Proactive learners : Enjoyment in mastering complex concepts and applying learnings in practical ways to make an impact.

Creative problem solvers: Ability to approach challenges creatively, thinking outside the box to find the best solutions.

Diversity & inclusion: Appreciation and respect for diverse perspectives and ability to share your own, and work inclusively.

Collaboration & entrepreneurial mindset: value working well with others, taking initiative, thriving in a team environment & bringing an innovative, problem-solving mindset.

Work eligibility: Candidates must hold permanent residency with a home country passport; visa sponsorship is not available.

Why Nutreco?

By choosing Nutreco, you’ll help us lead the change towards global sustainable food production, equipped with the best training and mentorship and a spirit of innovation. This program isn’t just about what you can bring to us, but how we can grow together, fostering a culture that sparks entrepreneurial mindset.

Young Professional Program description

We offer a special 18-month program, split into three six-month rotations on the job, normally in three different countries, in three different supply chain areas. The program is designed to help you fully develop yourself on a personal and professional level by understanding our end-to-end supply chain processes, including the interdependencies and interconnectedness between different areas. You will gain industry-specific knowledge and leverage the experience of experts in our different locations and Opcos.

Local hiring company - home location

You will spend the first six months at your home location gaining on-the-job experience with a real-life job, learning about key supply chain processes, systems, respective goods and services and dataflows. In parallel, you will also start to develop your personal network in a collaborative environment.

Plant and Opco locations

After the first six months working from your home location, you will spend several months in some of our international plants and locations. The focus here will be on gaining additional perspectives and learning about the day-to-day operational and strategic challenges. At this point, you may identify potential improvements to help us along in our continuous drive for optimisation.

YPP Academy Weeks

Each rotation starts with a Skills Development Academy week focused on job-specific learning and personal development. You will also meet your fellow global Young Professionals and benefit from a wide range of trainings and events.

During all the phases of your traineeship, you will work as part of the Supply Chain team on a challenging position, global project, operational business tasks and attend several training courses. This combination of on-the-job, projects, training and international experience will provide you with excellent skills and give you a solid head start on your career.

Step into your future

Recruitment process

  • Submit your application.

  • Interview: Connect with your potential future manager to discuss your aspirations and potential fit.

  • Assessment: Review your values alignment, personality, and ability with Nutreco’s needs.

  • Offer: Join us in Feeding the Future!

For application details and more, visit the Nutreco career site . And be quick – the journey begins soon, and we’re eager to welcome our new cohort of visionaries.

To be eligible, candidates must have completed their Master’s program before the traineeship 1st of October 2025, be willing to undertake regional/international assignments; embody the qualities of collaboration and have an entrepreneurial spirit.

Join Medpace at our Sao Paulo office! Our clinical operations activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, Contract Specialist to join our LatAm Site Contract Team within the Clinical Operations team. This position will report to the LatAm Senior Contract Manager and will play a key role in the study start-up and clinical trial management processes at Medpace. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the opportunity for you.

Responsibilities

  1. Is responsible for preparing, negotiating, tracking and finalizing the Confidentiality Agreements (CDA), Clinical Trial Agreements (CTA), Budgets and Letters of Indemnification (LOI) as well as Amendments to these documents, as needed.
  2. Manages all required contractual agreements with investigator sites, including distribution, negotiation of budget and language, tracking and finalization.
  3. Proactively identifies site contract related risks and potential roadblocks.
  4. Prepares contract approval timelines with investigators and leads efforts to obtain contract approval to meet study deliverables.
  5. Maintains communication with project team and sites regarding status of all contractual requirements.
  6. Collaborates with the project team to ensure the client deliverables and expectations are achieved.
  7. Liaises with internal customers to review contract or budget areas that impact final execution of site contracts.
  8. Maintains tracking regarding site contracts and provides regular updates as agreed by the study team to the project team and client regarding status and efforts to ensure timelines are maintained.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree in business administration, legal studies, or life sciences.
  2. Ability to work with internal and external customers/vendors to meet project-specific goals.
  3. Ability to manage high volume work and meet rigorous deadlines.
  4. Flexibility to strategically manage negotiations with minimal oversight.
  5. Ability to interact with site and other functional areas as secondary project contact for contracting issues and questions.
  6. Ability to manage time and project requirements based on study deliverables.
  7. CRO experience or investigator site experience negotiating site agreements preferred.
  8. Fluency in English. Portuguese desirable.

***We kindly ask to send applications in English & salary expectation in BRL***

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

People. Purpose. Passion. Make a Difference Tomorrow. Join Us Today.

The work we’ve done over the past 30+ years has positively impacted the lives of countless patients and families who face hundreds of diseases across all key therapeutic areas. The work we do today will improve the lives of people living with illness and disease in the future.

title: Sr Transaction Manager, Global Realty
description:
Amazon operates a world-class network of large, technologically advanced fulfillment centers and supporting operations across Brazil.

The Global Realty Team is responsible for acquisition and disposition of all facilities in the Amazon Fulfillment Network and other related business lines. This candidate will be a key part of the Real Estate Team. This individual will operate on both strategic and tactical levels and will be responsible for leading teams to continue the expansion of the Amazon facility network throughout Brazil. The Sr Transaction Manager will be responsible for site acquisition, due diligence, site development, entitlements, strategic partnering with developers, investors, and other stakeholders, negotiation of transaction documents, and related functions for large, complex projects.

This candidate will perform the full range of transaction management functions and lead internal and outsourced teams in an extremely fast-paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Manage a high volume deal flow of large, complex existing building leases and build to suit transactions.
  2. Innovate and execute processes and tools to ensure the complete cycle from site search through deal execution is completed consistently and predictably at a fast pace.
  3. Create, innovate and implement a relevant system of metrics to plan, manage, measure and evaluate performance pertaining to the transaction process.
  4. Effectively communicate expectations, requirements, and status of deals to key business partners – both internal and external.
  5. Manage an ever-changing variety of internal initiatives and projects.
  6. Continue to build a culture of speed, flexibility, and frugality with all business partners.
  7. Closely collaborate with Amazon operations, legal, finance, treasury, capacity planning, economic development, transportation, and engineering groups to deliver highly successful projects.
  8. Help grow the best transaction management operation of its kind in Brazil.
  9. Travel throughout Brazil up to 30% of the time.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Relevant experience in commercial real estate transactions directly for or on behalf of a principal real estate occupier
  • Relevant experience in Project management experience from due diligence and design phase through implementation and operation
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (read/write/verbal)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • In-depth knowledge of commercial real estate transactions and related components such as site selection, construction pricing, development, entitlements, due diligence, and leasing
  • Experience and competence utilizing commercial real estate software platforms
  • Ability to work in a high stress, fast-paced environment
  • Ability to manage multiple projects for multiple stakeholders at the same time
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining all deadlines and critical date obligations
  • Excellent and inherent competency with time management and organization
  • Excellent ability to communicate clearly, effectively, and with proper professionalism
  • Excellent ability to build trust among colleagues and service partners
  • Interpretation of commercial lease documents
  • Demonstrated ability to establish processes, workflows, standard procedures
  • Robust experience in commercial real estate operations
  • Experience with industrial real estate portfolios

description:
Diaverum is the global leader in renal care, focusing on improving the renal lives of patients—enabling them to live a full life.

Activities:

  1. Provide chronic dialysis therapy, including, but not limited to, the formulation of a dialysis plan with ultrafiltration, initiating dialysis through various access points, ensuring safety measures are met, and monitoring applicable vital signs for patients with chronic renal failure in accordance with the Care Plan.
  2. Prepare and administer medications, fluid therapy, or other treatments as prescribed by the doctor, and perform the necessary documentation in the patient’s record.

  6. Evaluate the patient’s clinical condition before and after the session, including vital signs and vascular access.
  7. Continuously observe vital signs and machine parameters during hemodialysis to ensure treatment efficacy and safety, adjusting blood flow and machine parameters as needed.
  8. Conduct a detailed initial assessment, gathering information on symptoms, medical history, and recent changes in health status.
  9. Inspect and care for the vascular access to prevent infections and complications, and provide the patient with home care instructions for the access point.
  10. Maintain detailed records on treatment, including vital data, machine parameters, and any adverse events. Ensure documentation is complete and accurate.
  11. Report changes in the patient’s condition and session results to the medical team and other healthcare professionals involved in care.
  12. Ensure all procedures are carried out according to the standards and protocols set by Diaverum Brazil.
  13. Provide ongoing education to the patient and their caregiver.
  14. Proactively participate in quality improvement programs.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing

description:
Aqui na Drogaderma a diversidade faz parte da nossa essência!

Venha fazer parte do Grupo Farmácia Artesanal!

Somos o maior Grupo de Farmácia Magistral da América Latina, estamos presentes em mais de 8 estados com mais de 100 lojas. Até 2026 chegaremos com 200 lojas e tudo isto só será possível através de um time altamente engajado e preparado. Já somos mais de 1000 colaboradores e agora queremos ter você fazendo parte deste time de feras.

O Grupo Farmácia Artesanal valoriza a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acredita no valor inerente de cada ser humano. Acreditamos que a força e a sustentabilidade da nossa empresa estão intrinsecamente ligadas à multiplicidade de perspectivas e experiências de nossa equipe.

Com esse compromisso em mente, queremos enfatizar que todas as oportunidades oferecidas estão abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Estamos comprometidos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acessível, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar e alcançar seu potencial máximo. Ao diversificar nossa equipe, podemos oferecer melhores soluções para nossos clientes e contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa e inclusiva.

Buscamos talentos que compartilhem dos valores com base no respeito, inovação, desenvolvimento, melhoria contínua e bons relacionamentos.

Se você tem paixão por aprender e colocar em prática o que aprende, trabalha de forma colaborativa, é inovador e gosta de compartilhar ideias e opiniões, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade de crescer e trabalhar em uma empresa que valoriza tudo isso.

Se identifica com esses valores? Está em busca de uma oportunidade de carreira? Se candidate em uma de nossas oportunidades e venha fazer parte da equipe da Drogaderma!

DIA A DIA

  1. Estudo e Aplicação da Farmacologia: Realização de estudos contínuos sobre os princípios ativos, suas propriedades, mecanismos de ação, indicações e contra-indicações, com a aplicação desses conhecimentos no processo de manipulação de medicamentos.
  2. Adesão à Legislação Farmacêutica: Acompanhamento e implementação das normas da ANVISA e das Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF), garantindo que todas as atividades e processos cumpram rigorosamente a legislação vigente.
  3. Execução das Técnicas de Manipulação de Medicamentos: Realização das técnicas de manipulação como pesagem, mistura, diluição, encapsulação e outros processos, assegurando a qualidade e precisão dos medicamentos manipulados.
  4. Gestão do Controle de Qualidade: Implementação e monitoramento de processos de controle de qualidade durante a manipulação, assegurando que todos os medicamentos atendam aos padrões exigidos de segurança e eficácia.
  5. Identificação de Interações Medicamentosas: Avaliação de possíveis interações entre os medicamentos manipulados e outros que o paciente esteja utilizando, promovendo a segurança do tratamento e prevenindo riscos.
  6. Gestão e Organização da Documentação: Manutenção de registros precisos e detalhados de receitas, processos de manipulação e resultados de controle de qualidade, garantindo rastreabilidade e transparência.
  7. Revisão e Conferência de Receitas Médicas: Realização de conferência detalhada de receitas médicas para garantir a correção das informações antes do início da manipulação, assegurando que as orientações médicas sejam seguidas corretamente.
  8. Supervisão das Atividades de Manipulação: Supervisão direta das atividades dos técnicos e auxiliares durante o processo de manipulação, garantindo que as boas práticas e os padrões de qualidade sejam rigorosamente seguidos.
  9. Avaliação Final dos Produtos Manipulados: Realização de uma avaliação criteriosa dos medicamentos manipulados, verificando aspectos como aparência, peso, rotulagem e conformidade com as especificações estabelecidas, para assegurar que o produto final esteja adequado.
  10. Capacitação e Treinamento da Equipe: Participação e coordenação de treinamentos para a equipe, promovendo o aprimoramento contínuo em técnicas de manipulação, controle de qualidade e atualizações regulatórias, garantindo a eficiência e qualidade no ambiente de trabalho.

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. AS CANDIDATURAS SÓ SERÃO CONSIDERADAS SE ENVIADAS ATRAVÉS DO FORMULÁRIO OFICIAL.

Pode parecer inusitado, mas o trabalho de um BDR-Closer é mais parecido com o de um diretor de cinema do que com o de um vendedor – e aqui vão 5 razões para isso:

  1. Existem inúmeras oportunidades de venda no mercado, mas é o BDR- Closer que transforma a oportunidade em uma história de sucesso (fechamento);

  3. Diretores BDRs- Closers que seguem o roteiro, palavra por palavra, podem ser previsíveis, mas os nossos sabem quando improvisar para garantir o impacto e ganhar o cliente;
  4. A forma de contar a história (a abordagem de venda) é tão importante quanto o enredo (os argumentos para encantamento do cliente);
  5. Uma má direção pode arruinar o desfecho e não impactar o cliente (e aí a gente perde a venda).

Poderíamos dar mais 10 takes sobre isso, mas se você é apaixonado por vendas e por comunicação e marketing, e quer estar à frente e dirigir os melhores finais, essa oportunidade é para você! A vaga de Business Development Representative Closer da Fundamento está aberta!

description:
Join to apply for the Data Engineer role at Ryz Labs .

Ryz Labs is looking for a Data Engineer to help enhance and stabilize the data monitoring system for one of our biggest clients. The role focuses on building robust, scalable, and proactive alerting workflows to ensure high data quality and reliability across pipelines. You will collaborate with the data engineering team to improve orchestration and monitoring using tools like Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and AWS services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement a resilient data monitoring framework to improve incident detection and reduce false positives.
  • Enhance alerting mechanisms for pipeline failures, data anomalies, and data freshness across Snowflake and dbt models.
  • Streamline orchestration and dependency management in Airflow to increase reliability and observability.
  • Integrate AWS DMS, Kinesis, and Firehose monitoring into our centralized alerting system.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and implement meaningful metrics for data health.
  • Document monitoring architecture and ensure knowledge transfer to internal teams.

Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of Snowflake architecture, performance tuning, and metadata management.
  • Experience creating and maintaining dbt models with test coverage and clear documentation.
  • Expertise in managing Airflow DAGs, handling retries, and structuring tasks for reliability and visibility; experience with Astronomer is a bonus.
  • Deep familiarity with AWS DMS, Kinesis, and Firehose, especially around monitoring and alerting integrations.
  • Experience with data monitoring tools or custom observability frameworks.

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio founded in 2021 by entrepreneurs with experience at major tech companies and iconic brands. Based in Argentina, the team is remote and distributed across the US and Latam. We leverage cutting-edge cloud technologies to build scalable, resilient applications and aim to create multiple startups in the coming years.

At RYZ, you will work with autonomy, ownership, and opportunities for growth. We foster an environment of learning, innovation, and challenging projects, where you can deepen your expertise and collaborate with talented professionals.

title: Senior Pre-Sales Technical Advisor
description:
If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do:

The Pre-Sales Engineer will work with the Direct Sales and Alliance teams to provide technical support during the sales cycle for our solutions, acting as the bridge between sales and product, professional services, and support. You will utilize technical expertise to support the sales team and deliver solutions that meet customer needs.

The Senior Pre-Sales Technical Advisor will be adept at leveraging technical expertise to deliver innovative solutions, ensuring seamless integration of product offerings with client needs. This role requires strong communication skills to enable effective cross-functional collaboration and the successful execution of complex sales initiatives. Known for developing robust sales strategies, conducting impactful product demonstrations, and providing comprehensive technical support to both clients and internal sales teams

More specifically you will:

  • Maintain an expert-level understanding of the functionality and technical architecture of our products.
  • Conduct the client discovery process to uncover unforeseen challenges and ensure the proper offering is being proposed.
  • Develop a firm understanding of customer needs, pain points, and requirements around the compliance process for the Brazilian market, aligning Sovos solutions to eliminate pain points and fulfill needs.
  • Work closely with Sovos’ Sales team to conduct sales and solution presentations for Strategic Enterprise and Mid-Size clients.
  • Design and deliver customized solution demonstrations using Sovos SaaS solutions and services.
  • Drive new brokerage sales opportunities with Alliances and work to upsell the current client base with account management.
  • Assist in the creation of RFP and RFI responses for prospective new clients.
  • Work closely with Implementation and Product Teams to ensure a seamless handoff from sales to onboarding for new clients.
  • Maintain and continually improve demonstration capabilities, conducting internal sales department training, demo system preparation, and proposal content development.
  • Act with integrity and demonstrate ethical behavior in all matters with stakeholders.
  • Take full responsibility for ensuring internal and external customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate initiative, drive, and determination to achieve results, success, and growth.
  • Maintain a high level of energy, enthusiasm, engagement, and commitment to action.
  • Demonstrate a high degree of self-awareness and a commitment to personal development and learning.

What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of experience and education.
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian compliance environment.
  • Customer-facing experience is required.
  • Strong team orientation with a history of working collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize activities.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office software, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed.
  • Moderate travel required for client meetings, trade shows, Sovos events, and special projects.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues, and customers.
  • Comprehend and communicate complex concepts.
  • Analyze and resolve complex problems.
  • Utilize technology (e.g., phone systems, computer hardware, and software applications) to fulfill work requirements.

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside

  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs
  • Virtual English Club through Rosetta Stone, and more!

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us onLinkedIn andTwitter .

Sobre a Bahiana

A Bahiana é uma instituição de direito privado, sem fins econômicos, de caráter educacional, cultural, científico e assistencial, com foco no ensino, na pesquisa e na extensão dos conhecimentos e serviços próprios da área de saúde, das ciências em geral e da cultura para oferecer à comunidade.

Seu principal objetivo é formar profissionais qualificados com base em valores éticos e humanísticos .

Em mais de 70 anos de história , já diplomou mais de 17 mil profissionais da área de saúde. Além disso, é uma Escola nota 5, a nota máxima na avaliação do MEC que menos de 3% das instituições de ensino no Brasil, entre públicas e particulares, possuem .

Recentemente, a Bahiana ganhou, pelo sexto ano consecutivo, o prêmio Great Place To Work (GPTW) , premiação global atribuída às empresas que, de acordo com os seus funcionários, são os melhores lugares para trabalhar. Permanecemos no 1º lugar no ranking das melhores empresas para trabalhar na Bahia.

Em sua grade, a Bahiana possui cursos de graduação em Medicina, Fisioterapia, Odontologia, Psicologia, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Educação Física e Tecnólogo em Informática em Saúde, este na modalidade de Educação a Distância. Além da graduação, são mais de 25 cursos de Especialização, Mestrado e Doutorado, sem contar os mais de 20 programas sociais e os cursos de Extensão.

Para além da educação em saúde, a Bahiana Saúde, que abarca o Centro Médico e o Centro Odontológico da Bahiana, presta serviços de saúde à população , contando com o Ambulatório da Comunidade, com as Clínicas de Psicologia e Fisioterapia e com a Clínica Odontológica, além de mais atendimentos em diversas áreas de saúde.

Trabalhar na Bahiana é ter o que chamamos de "Bahianidade na veia" . É compartilhar dos nossos valores de Servir, Empreender, Comunicar, Aprender e ensinar . É por isso que queremos agregar talentos que valorizem a nossa tradição , mas que, como a instituição, mirem no futuro, na inovação e no trabalho para a construção de um mundo no qual a saúde seja valorizada como um direito básico e universal.

Informações da Vaga

Descrição

Prestar assistência farmacêutica; esclarecer possíveis dúvidas sobre a posologia e formas distintas de administração de medicamentos, de acordo com a necessidade ou solicitações de clientes, mediante leitura, pesquisas junto aos fabricantes, órgãos públicos e privados especializados; atender os clientes de forma humanizada, para a dispensação de medicamentos aos pacientes, ler e interpretar os receituários médicos, buscar o produto, orientar o cliente quanto ao seu uso e aplicação (posologia, cuidados, possíveis efeitos colaterais, etc.) e processar a venda, visando a satisfação do cliente e a manutenção dos padrões de qualidade definidos pela empresa para o atendimento ao público.

Responsabilizar-se pelo processo de identificação de usuários de medicamentos controlados, de acordo com a legislação; orientar e supervisionar os demais colaboradores da sua loja, quanto à atuação na dispensação de medicamentos, sempre que necessário; acompanhar e manter o controle sobre os prazos de validade dos medicamentos, realizando a segregação e o envio de medicamentos para o destino correto; conferir e controlar os estoques de medicamentos, sendo responsável direto pelos estoques dos medicamentos controlados e antibióticos, mantendo o armário de psicotrópicos chaveado e com placa de identificação.

Manter-se atento à precificação dos produtos expostos e seus prazos de validade; responsabilizar-se pela condição de armazenamento dos produtos e sua reposição, bem como zelar pela correta precificação dos itens e estreita observação dos prazos de validade fixados nas embalagens; realizar relatório diário da movimentação dos medicamentos controlados e antibióticos, anexando as receitas das respectivas vendas; realizar balanços (mensais, trimestrais e anuais) das listas obrigatórias da Portaria 344/98; realizar semanalmente a auditoria de estoque dos medicamentos controlados, por meio de sistema informatizado da empresa, mantendo o armário com estoque correto.

Limpar e organizar o armário dos medicamentos controlados, cuidando o prazo de validade dos mesmos, com intuito de não perder nenhum prazo de validade; orientar os demais colaboradores sobre o correto preenchimento e uso do carimbo de receituários específicos, e quanto ao preenchimento no computador, onde os dados devem ser fiéis às receitas, com todos os campos corretamente preenchidos; promover treinamentos de vendas, mediante controle, supervisão e acompanhamento nos programas Farmácia Popular, dispensação de psicotrópicos, obedecendo às normas, legislações vigentes e negociações realizadas com órgãos públicos.

Arquivar e responsabilizar-se pela autorização de funcionamento concedida pela Vigilância Sanitária para o sistema informatizado de venda de medicamentos controlados (SNGPC); manter atualizado, arquivado e válido o Alvará Sanitário (ou protocolo-SUS), Autorização de Funcionamento (Anivsa), Licença de Funcionamento (Prefeitura), Certidão de Regularidade (CRF), Alvará dos Bombeiros, Certificado de Dedetização e demais documentos obrigatórios; manter a placa de identificação da farmácia atualizada, contendo: Nome fantasia, razão social, endereço, n de registro no CRF, CNPJ, inscrição estadual, nome dos farmacêuticos titular e substitutos com n de registro junto ao CRF e respectivos horários de funcionamento da loja e telefones do CRF, Vigilância Sanitária Estadual e Municipal e PROCON.

Manter atualizado o Manual de Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas, POP’s e Plano de Gerenciamento de Resíduos (PGRSS) e os aplicar de acordo com orientação; possuir arquivada a cópia do contrato de prestação de serviço com a empresa de coleta de resíduos e da licença de operação e transporte da mesma, junto a Fepan; manter cadastro atualizado anualmente de todos os fornecedores de medicamentos, com autorização de Funcionamento da Anvisa, Alvará Sanitário, Alvará de Localização e Funcionamento, CNPJ, CRF, publicação no DOU (Diário Oficial da União) e autorização especial, quando houver; manter o registro de treinamentos aplicados à sua equipe.

Emitir relatórios e preencher planilhas diversas para atender à legislação quanto ao controle de medicamentos especiais ou relatar a devolução de medicamentos por prazo vencido; atender a fiscalização de órgãos públicos (CRF, Vigilância Sanitária e outros) providenciando a documentação requerida ou proceder aos ajustes necessários apontados pelos Auditores; manter o guia da farmácia digital atualizado nos computadores, para fins de consulta de clientes e colaboradores; reter a receita na venda de medicamentos; recepcionar os clientes, aviar receitas, fornecer orientações necessárias ao cliente sobre o medicamento; manter o setor organizado, supervisionando a higienização do ambiente.

Manter-se atualizado sobre as características dos medicamentos novos, conforme divulgações dos laboratórios ou informações contidas nas bulas, utilizando tais conhecimentos para o benefício dos clientes e repassando-os aos colegas; auxiliar na reposição das mercadorias e conhecer a disposição e organização dos produtos na loja; efetuar troca de mercadorias para clientes, com autorização do superior, cumprindo políticas específicas; participar das reuniões, cursos e treinamentos para conhecimento de alterações ou novas políticas adotadas; auxiliar no levantamento do estoque físico para fins de balanço, quando solicitado; nas filiais que dispõem de Salas de Serviços Farmacêuticos, realizar atendimento aos pacientes, conforme serviços disponibilizados; garantir o funcionamento do sistema SGNPC, por meio da verificação e envio de relatórios, além do monitoramento de possíveis intercorrências; garantir o controle de temperatura de ambiente e de geladeiras, mediante apresentação de planilhas de monitoramento; cumprir e exigir que processos da loja sejam realizados obedecendo às normas e legislações vigentes.

title: Systeemtherapeut
description:
Werken bij Stichting JA! – Dichtbij, Outreachend en Betekenisvol

Bij Stichting JA! staan we midden tussen de inwoners in de wijk. We bieden aanvullende gespecialiseerde jeugdhulp in Amsterdam, Diemen, Uithoorn en Ouder-Amstel, zonder onnodige drempels. Onze aanpak? Outreachend, laagdrempelig en dichtbij, bij gezinnen thuis, op scholen en op alle plekken waar jeugdigen zich bevinden.

In onze multidisciplinaire gebiedsteams bundelen we de krachten met professionals uit verschillende organisaties. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat gezinnen snel en effectief de juiste ondersteuning krijgen. Geen hulpvraag is hetzelfde, en dát maakt ons werk dynamisch, uitdagend en ontzettend waardevol.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je wordt onderdeel van een gedreven gebiedsteams in de regio {VUL IN}

Samen met psychiaters, (GZ-)psychologen, orthopedagogen(-generalisten), systeemtherapeuten, jeugd- en gezinscoaches en IAG-ers werk je aan complexe hulpvragen. We kijken juist niet alleen naar problemen, maar vooral naar de kracht en veerkracht van elk gezin.

Waarom kiezen voor Stichting JA!?

  • Dichtbij en betrokken: Je bent aanwezig in de wijk en staat letterlijk naast gezinnen.
  • Systemisch werken: Alleen door systemisch te werken, komen we samen tot duurzame oplossingen.
  • Maatwerk : Geen standaardoplossingen, maar hulp die écht past.
  • Sterk netwerk: Samenwerken met specialisten uit verschillende disciplines.
  • Ruimte om te groeien : Je leert van de specialisten om je heen én krijgt de vrijheid om je te ontwikkelen in de richting die bij jou past

Wil jij bijdragen aan een veerkrachtige jeugd in Amsterdam en omstreken? Sluit je aan bij ons team!

Als Systeemtherapeut bij Stichting JA! werk je met gezinnen die te maken hebben met complexe problematiek. Je staat midden in de leefwereld van gezinnen en bent daar waar het écht nodig is: thuis bij gezinnen, op school of in de wijk.

Je kijkt niet alleen naar het individu, maar naar het hele gezinssysteem en de bredere context. Samen met het gezin onderzoek je vastgelopen patronen en help je bij het herstellen van verbindingen en het versterken van veerkracht. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s in het gebiedsteam en draagt bij aan een warme, systemische aanpak waarin de cliënt centraal staat.

Waar kom je in dienst?

Iedereen die werkzaam is bij Stichting JA! is in dienst van een van onze moederorganisaties. Onze moederorganisaties zijn: FamilySupporters, Groei & Glunder, Timon, Terminal 18, Zigzag Kindzorg, Fibbe.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent een enthousiaste, positieve collega en je omarmt onze manier van werken;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met het werken met gezinnen die kampen met complexe problematiek en bent in staat ‘out-of-the-box’ oplossingen voor hen te creëren;
  • Je wordt enthousiast van outreachend werken, waarbij je midden tussen de gezinnen in de wijk staat;
  • Je bent een verbindende persoonlijkheid die in staat is integraal samen te werken; zowel met het systeem van het gezin, als met andere betrokken partijen, zoals het ouder- kindteam, buurtteam en jeugdhulpverleners van andere jeugdhulporganisaties;
  • Je vindt het leuk om jouw kennis over te dragen aan collega’s om met elkaar verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Je durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en bent initiatiefnemend;
  • Een afgeronde opleiding tot Systeemtherapeut;
  • Je bent in het bezit van een NVRG-registratie
  • Je bent in het bezit van een SKJ-registratie

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een gedreven, multidisciplinair team waar collegialiteit, overleg en van elkaar leren (casuïstiek, intervisie en werkbegeleiding) centraal staan.
  • Ruimte om zelf te blijven groeien als professional, door ervaring en door de opleidingsmogelijkheden die we bieden.
  • JA! organiseert vier keer per jaar inhoudelijke kennissessies met gastsprekers om de kwaliteit en inhoud van ons werk verder te versterken.
  • Een team waarin iedereen zich welkom en gezien voelt, ongeacht culturele achtergrond, religie of levensstijl.
  • De ruimte om jouw werkweek in te vullen op een manier die voor jou werkt;
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris en 8% vakantietoeslag;
  • Reiskosten vergoeding of een NS-businesskaart;
  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;
  • De ruimte om samen met bevlogen collega’s JA! verder te ontwikkelen en actief bij te dragen aan de toekomst van de jeugdhulp in Amsterdam.

Enthousiast geraakt?

Ben jij een Systeemtherapeut en word jij net zo enthousiast over de kansen en mogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie als wij dat zijn? Dan praten we graag verder! Stuur jouw CV naar of neem contact op voor een (verkennend) gesprek via of 06-40239002.

description:
Senior Technical Analyst - Cyber Security

Company: Ball Corporation

Location: SÃO Jose Dos Campos, São Paulo, BR, 12246-876

Date: Feb 20, 2025

Job Category: IT Administration

Req. ID: 41189

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Please, submit your resume in English .

Ball Corporation is looking for a well-rounded team player with broad technical leadership skills to add to our Global IT Security operations department. This position requires extensive knowledge in three or more of the following IT Security tools: Firewalls, Web Content Filtering, Web Application and Malware Protection, Intrusion Prevention System, SSL Decryption, Email Security, Strong Authentication, Remote Access, End Point Protection, Advanced Threat Management, Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation, Identity Management, Data Loss Prevention, Data Encryption, Security Incident Management, Public Key Infrastructure, Web Application Firewall, IT Security Forensics, Password Vaulting, Risk assessment, and security vulnerability assessment.

This position works within the Global IT Security team to solve complex IT Security problems by taking a broad perspective to identify innovative technical solutions. The successful candidate will provide mentorship and guidance to junior level cyber security analysts. The position also participates in managing our vendors to achieve the desired results including quality and on-time delivery. Working knowledge and relevant certifications in the above security tools is preferred.

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Security administration is a hands-on role that requires a high level of technical expertise including networking, operating systems, applications, cloud environments, and security.
  2. Responsible for a broad range of security tasks, including the day-to-day security administration of network security devices, as well as the management of technologies, such as firewall, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, data loss prevention, antivirus, anti-spam, antispyware, and security information and event management (SIEM) tools.
  3. Monitor, analyze, and respond to security incidents and breaches swiftly and effectively, minimizing potential impact.
  4. Lead incident response efforts, coordinate investigations, and ensure all incidents are properly documented and reported.
  5. Serve as a subject matter expert on cybersecurity matters, both internally and externally.
  6. Conduct regular security audits and assessments to identify weaknesses in networks, systems, and applications, and recommend remediation actions.
  7. Create and maintain system and network diagrams as well as process documentation.
  8. Provide support to ensure planning and deployment is accomplished in coordination with system owners, engineers, and stakeholders and are consistent with appropriate infrastructure and security engineering requirements.
  9. Assess and prioritize cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities across the organization's technology landscape.
  10. Follow up on remediation of vulnerabilities.
  11. Participate in design and implementation of new security controls.
  12. Stay current with cybersecurity threats and trends, providing ongoing intelligence and insights to inform security decision-making.
  13. Create and modify procedural documentation as needed.
  14. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and frameworks, such as SOX, HIPAA, or NIST.
  15. Develop and maintain incident response plans, disaster recovery plans, and business continuity strategies to ensure resilience in the face of cybersecurity threats.
  16. Ensure that all information systems operate in accordance with set standards.
  17. Participate in an on-call rotation with the department.
  18. Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Unit, and the Company.

Main Requirements/Knowledge

  1. Advanced Level of English.
  2. Experience in a cyber-security operations environment including 4+ years of technical leadership.
  3. CISSP, CISM, CISA certifications preferred; other security relevant certifications considered.
  4. Knowledge of CISCO ASA solutions specifically remote access.
  5. Technical “hands-on” proficiency with at least three security-related systems and applications.
  6. Technical proficiency with security-related systems and applications, especially mainstream OS’s.
  7. Experience in documenting and maintaining processes and procedures.
  8. Knowledge of information security principles, including risk assessment, intrusion detection, and network access control.
  9. Knowledge of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, and associated network protocols and concepts.
  10. Knowledge of SANS Twenty Critical Controls information security policies, procedures, guidelines, and methodologies desired.
  11. A strong familiarity with cryptographic concepts and their practical application.
  12. Experience in securing Cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, SAP, etc.
  13. Knowledge and Understanding of the CI/CD Pipeline along with tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo.
  14. Experience in driving technology solutions in large, complex organizations.
  15. Proven focus in metrics-driven delivery: defining Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring SLAs, and enhancing environment to meet SLAs.
  16. Experience in driving process and technology re-engineering using industry practices.

Our client is undertaking a large number of brownfield and greenfield projects in order to support and enhance production over the coming years.

The role includes significant people leadership and stakeholder management in an organisation of significant scale and complexity.

  • Operations Readiness and Start-Up Manager is accountable to support projects and operations, acting as an interface in delivery of operations readiness for projects in service of safe, reliable and compliant start-up in the field.
  • Accountable for projects’ start-up in the field and pre-requisite activities to enable safe and efficient operations.
  • Understanding and experience in Operations Readiness & Assurance (OR&A) Delivery Requirements and project stage Gate readiness;
  • Proactive engagement with all operating departments to ensure the development will integrate into existing Brownfield Assets;
  • Promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
  • Accountable to interface with Project Management team at earlier stage of the project to ensure provision of Operations and Commissioning inputs and planning are considered to deliver the project in accordance with the Scope of requirements (SOR).
  • Establish an O&M strategy for startup and earlier Operations phases and ensure strategy is reviewed and accepted by all project stakeholders.

  • Develop and monitor key performance Indicators to measure the effectiveness of the different phases of the O&M Scope.
  • Support the project assurance processes (such as Model Reviews / Hazop, Hazid, etc).
  • Manage the acceptance & handover from Project to Operations using the approved certification process (such Guidance OF Certification) ensuring a structured plan is developed in advance and implemented at the different project phases.
  • Ensure that Contractor documents (Plans, Manuals, procedures, and Method Statements) are reviewed and commented by Operations and readiness team members.
  • Ensure start up and ramp up plans are developed taking inputs from project stakeholders to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Contractor Commissioning and Start-up Team to ensure commissioning and start-up activities are planned and scheduled in line with the project standards and procedures. Descrição

Estamos buscando um(a) Business Architect de Growth para atuar como ponte entre as áreas de marketing, produto, dados e tecnologia. Essa pessoa será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções que otimizem e acelerem as alavancas de crescimento, como CAC, LTV, conversão, recorrência, engajamento, expansão de canais e eficiência de aquisição.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter a arquitetura de crescimento da Insider, conectando processos de negócio, dados e soluções tecnológicas.
  • Mapear e documentar jornadas de aquisição, ativação, conversão e retenção, identificando pontos de melhoria e oportunidades de escala.
  • Investigar gargalos em funis de growth, canais de mídia, experimentos e fluxos do usuário, utilizando dados, entrevistas, análises e shadowing.

  • Apoiar a priorização de iniciativas e definir roadmaps de crescimento.
  • Acompanhar e medir o impacto das soluções implementadas, garantindo ciclos ágeis de aprendizado.
  • Ser um agente de mudança, articulando com stakeholders e influenciando decisões estratégicas.
  • Propor frameworks para teste, experimentação e escalabilidade de canais, produtos e campanhas.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado em growth, marketing, dados e automação para gerar vantagem competitiva.
  • Coordenar a governança de processos de growth, garantindo consistência, alinhamento e eficiência.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Economia, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (SQL, Python, BigQuery).
  • Raciocínio lógico, pensamento estruturado e capacidade analítica apurada.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em times multidisciplinares e ambientes ambíguos.
  • Experiência com projetos de melhoria de processos, estruturação de times ou desenho de soluções operacionais.
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e perfil hands-on.

A Insider nasceu para desafiar o status quo da indústria da moda. Desde 2017, aprendemos, inovamos e buscamos a excelência, criando um mundo onde todos são encorajados a subir a barra.

Hoje, temos mais de 800 mil clientes e um portfólio que combina tecnologia, inovação e sustentabilidade. Esta é apenas a nossa jornada de transformação na indústria da moda, uma das mais tradicionais e poluentes do mundo.

description:
MiQ is looking for an Account Manager to join our team in the upcoming months. The candidate will be empowered to protect and grow client relationships across a portfolio of advertisers. The role offers the opportunity to join an innovative company, with award winning culture and ambitious growth plans.

The Account Manager will be tasked with growing existing business through delivering best-in-class service for clients, strategic insights presentations, and

upholding internal operational excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work collaboratively with sales, trading, product and analytics on some of the world’s most known brands.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

In the role you will be accountable for, but not limited to, the following: Client Service:

  • Craft and present best in class insight reports that blend campaign performance and real business challenges, telling a story with our MiQ data
  • Contribute to business retention and growth by identifying incremental opportunities, growing accounts & strategizing new solutions on an ongoing basis, including recommendation of additional products and channels
  • Supporting a portfolio of clients and ensuring that all are performing optimally; working in partnership with Trading team to ensure campaigns are pacing as desired

Project Management:

  • Work hand in hand with regional “pod” to ensure client demands are met and client’s expectations are exceeded. This role is responsible for ensuring all client deliverables are best in class and delivered on time
  • Help to identify gaps and establish strategic processes as part of new product rollouts, specifying needs for AM team and any downstream impacts

Internal Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with internal teams across region(s) to encourage ongoing thought leadership & MiQ product diversification
  • Attend all AM-related trainings and completion of Accreditation modules to ensure product knowledge remains current
  • Build rapport and foster positive collaboration with the Sales & Trading team on your commercial pod

Communication:

  • Lead weekly pod syncs and regional Board (client performance review) meetings, keeping all teams aligned on any updates and/or next steps ● Articulating to clients how MiQ’s agnostic approach and Trading technology/ expertise sets us apart
  • Collaborate with Senior Team Members across commercial business to provide support on key accounts
  • Strategize within AM department and the Commercial pod to grow and develop existing client business
  • Staying close with clients by reading related company news or industry trades, attend earnings calls to serve as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and clients

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of advertising technology and/or media planning experience
  • Experience with Programmatic Advertising is highly preferred; need for understanding of digital ecosystem and vendor-agency-advertiser dynamic
  • Commercial experience – clear evidence of servicing advertisers to a high standard and growing business from “one-time deals” to strategic partnerships measured through revenue and/or business line growth
  • A+ presentation skills with the ability to turn data points into a compelling media story.

Systems:

  • Experience with Google Campaign Manager, Sizmek MDX
  • Expertise with the Microsoft Office Suite
  • Salesforce, and Atlassian (JIRA) understanding preferred but not required ● Experience with Tag Managements systems is a plus!

Disposition:

  • Alignment with MiQ's core values
  • Competitive ‘winning’ mentality with a vision to grow your career as the company scales

What’s in it for you

MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to

make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.

Values:

Our values are so much more than statements. They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do - no matter how big or small.

  • We do what we love - Passion
  • We figure it out - Determination
  • We anticipate the unexpected - Agility
  • We dare to be unconventional - Courage

Every region and office has specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:

  • A hybrid work environment
  • New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training ● Internal and global mobility opportunities
  • Bonus and performance incentives
  • Generous annual PTO, paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives
  • Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities

MiQ Pay Philosophy

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Brazil , MiQ is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Brazil and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At MiQ, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $260,000 - $289,000 BRL . This range may vary for positions outside of Brazil as it has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled and does not take into account our bonus and commission structures.

Regardless of location, candidates can expect during the first few conversations with MiQ’s Talent team and Hiring Managers to share any approved budget and details on our competitive bonus and commission packages. Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder

  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e implementar ações para otimizar a eficiência e reduzir os custos.
  • Gestão de fornecedores: Interagir com fornecedores de serviços e materiais de manutenção, buscando as melhores condições de contratação e negociação. Avaliar o desempenho dos fornecedores e garantir a qualidade dos serviços e materiais entregues.

Requisitos:

description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores
  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance? Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!


Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos
Pré-requisitos Essenciais
  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais
  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto
  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou


Etapas do Processo
  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  • Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios Que Oferecemos

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: AUXILIAR ADMINISTRATIVO (COTA EXCLUSIVA PARA PCD) - VITÓRIA DE SANTO ANTÃO/PE
description:
Um auxiliar administrativo desempenha uma variedade de tarefas e funções de apoio em um ambiente de escritório ou organização. Sua principal responsabilidade é ajudar na administração e no gerenciamento eficiente das atividades diárias do local de trabalho.

O auxiliar administrativo geralmente lida com tarefas de rotina, como receber e responder chamadas telefônicas, fazer e receber correspondências, organizar e arquivar documentos, gerenciar agendas e agendamentos, coordenar reuniões e preparar a documentação necessária. Eles também podem ser responsáveis pela manutenção de registros e sistemas de arquivamento eletrônico.

Além disso, um auxiliar administrativo pode auxiliar na preparação de relatórios financeiros e na manutenção de registros contábeis básicos, como lançamentos de despesas e receitas. Eles podem ajudar na gestão de suprimentos de escritório, fazer pedidos de material e garantir que os estoques sejam mantidos adequadamente.

Em resumo, o papel de um auxiliar administrativo é fornecer suporte e assistência em várias áreas administrativas, garantindo a eficiência e a organização do escritório ou organização em que trabalham. Eles desempenham um papel crucial no funcionamento diário do local de trabalho e ajudam a manter as operações administrativas em andamento de forma eficaz.

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Partner Success Manager role at monday.com

Our Partnerships Group is growing, and we are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the team! This role is ideal for experienced Customer Success professionals looking to leverage their expertise in driving customer outcomes by enabling partners to excel. You’ll work closely with our business partners and their clients (both existing and new prospects) to ensure monday.com’s partners deliver the best value to their business needs and challenges.

This is a key position to help shape our Partnerships’ Customer Success strategy and Customer Excellence team.

In this role, you will build the foundations for our partner-focused customer success program, aligning proven CS practices with scalable, business-oriented solutions.

Please note that this role is on a hybrid model and will require 3 days in office out of São Paulo.

About The Role

  1. Work closely with the Partnerships and Customer Success teams to share portfolio insights of their partners.
  2. Directly collaborate with partners to enhance and align their customer success practices with best-in-class methodologies, ensuring optimal retention and satisfaction across their customer portfolios.
  3. Work closely with regional leaders, serving as the primary post-sale customer success expert in our partnership organization.
  4. Provide onboarding and training for new partners to ensure they’re able to help teams find value with monday.com.
  5. Develop and execute strategic plans with partners to drive customer outcomes, increase NDR, and scale client success initiatives.
  6. Forecast and track key account metrics.
  7. Prepare regular reports of progress and forecasts to internal and external stakeholders.
  8. Provide professional support to enhance customer-centric approaches across partner portfolios and deepen dedication to monday.com.

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of experience in Customer Success Management within a SaaS environment, driving measurable client outcomes and retention.
  2. Fluent in English & Portuguese.
  3. Experience working in business organizations, managing cross-functional stakeholders, and negotiating solutions.
  4. Familiarity in collaborating with developers, engineers, and product managers to meet customer requirements.
  5. Strong customer-facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with executives.
  6. Demonstrated success in developing scalable customer success strategies and working with client-facing teams to deliver impactful results.
  7. Excellent technical project management skills, enabling multiple cross-functional teams to deliver against plan.
  8. Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  9. Analytical skills and passion toward technology.

Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available.

title: Mãe denuncia injúria racial sofrida por filha no Senai, em Divinópolis
description:
• Mãe denuncia injúria racial sofrida por filha no Senai, emDivinópolis

Mãe denuncia injúria racial sofridapor filha no Senai, em Divinópolis

Uma mulher gravou um vídeo nesta quinta-feira (27) por meio doqual denuncia uma situação de injúria racial sofrida pela filha, noSenai, que fica no bairro Esplanada, em Divinópolis. Conforme asexplicações dela, um colega de classe da filha seria o responsávelpelo crime.

Durante o vídeo, a mãe conta que foi até a escola parasolucionar o problema, na manhã de hoje (27), e que a luta éconstante e que não permitirá que tal situação aconteça com afilha. A mãe reforça também a necessidade de autovalorização erespeito. O SENAI se posicionou sobre o caso, informando que nãoteve envolvimento de nenhum funcionário da escola, e que lamenta oocorrido com a estudante. A escola informou ainda que o causador dainjúria racial, sendo outro estudante da instituição, passará pormedidas reeducativas. Veja abaixo o posicionamento completodo SENAI e também o vídeo feito pela mãe.

“O SENAI Anielo Greco, localizado em Divinópolis, lamentaprofundamente o episódio de injúria racial ocorrido nasdependências da unidade e esclarece que as ofensas racistas foramproferidas por um aluno menor de idade, direcionadas a uma colega,não havendo envolvimento de nenhum colaborador daentidade.

É importante ressaltar que, desde o momento em que foiinformada sobre o ocorrido, o SENAI escutou, acolheu e garantiu àvítima e sua mãe a devida apuração dos fatos e a tomada dasprovidências cabíveis. Para tanto, foi necessário um tempo mínimopara a realização de diligências e a análise das metodologiaspedagógicas já previstas pela entidade, o que foi acordado entre aspartes.

Com o intuito de manter seu compromisso de trabalhar pelaformação integral do indivíduo, a definição da medida disciplinarpertinente ao caso deve levar em consideração o contexto social efamiliar do aluno. Dessa forma, o SENAI age no sentido de educar osjovens para além da competência técnica, acreditando no processo deformação cidadã e preparando o indivíduo para viver em sociedadecom respeito e dignidade.

Diante do exposto, o SENAI reitera que as medidasdisciplinares pertinentes estão sendo definidas com o objetivo deeducar e recuperar o indivíduo. A entidade reafirma seu repúdio aqualquer tipo de preconceito e se coloca como parceira da sociedadeno processo de transformação cidadã”.

title: Operador de Cedoc (Exclusiva PcD)
description:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth story while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

VENHA E CRESÇA JUNTO COM A GENTE!

Estamos em busca de Operador de Cedoc!

Coloque suas habilidades e conhecimentos em prática e faça a diferença! Se gosta de movimento, trabalho em altura (superior a 2 metros) e organização, essa oportunidade é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Respeitar as normas e procedimentos de segurança e uso de EPI’s (Equipamento de Proteção Individual) fornecidos pela empresa e higiene do trabalho estabelecidas para a sua área de atuação;
  2. Implantar e incluir volumes (caixas) no sistema interno SKP (SafeKeeper), receber e conferir a demanda, efetuar a troca da cartonagem quando necessário e liberar volume para a guarda, mantendo assim a organização e garantia dos processos;
  3. Movimentar caixas manualmente ou com auxílio de equipamentos manuais ou de força motriz própria, dentro das dependências da Unidade;
  4. Localizar, quais os locais (endereços) em que as caixas serão guardadas conforme sistema interno SKP, e levá-las a este local, utilizando-se de diversos recursos, como: leitor de código de barras, carrinhos, escadas, prateleiras equipadas com rodízios, etc;
  5. Procurar e localizar caixas de documentos, seguindo instruções ou indicações de endereços (corredores, prateleiras, níveis, etc) estabelecidos pelos procedimentos vigentes ou instruções dadas pelo superior. Após os trabalhos de pesquisa, retornar estes volumes ao local inicial;
  6. Preencher relatórios de suas atividades diárias (formulário OPLOG), conforme os modelos e procedimentos IMB, para avaliação e controle da produção individual e do departamento;
  7. Zelar para que todos os volumes e equipamentos usados sejam preservados nas condições de conservação;
  8. Relatar qualquer alteração ou irregularidade nos equipamentos de movimentação de carga, auxiliando no preenchimento da lista de verificação (check-list);
  9. Quando não há trabalhos de sua função direta poderá auxiliar os demais departamentos.

REQUISITOS

  1. Ensino Médio completo
  2. Atenção concentrada, agilidade, proatividade, organização do trabalho e Trabalho em equipe.

Aplique-se agora!

Mal podemos esperar para ouvir mais sobre você! Junte-se à Iron Mountain, onde Cultura e Valores são praticados e respeitados todos os dias!

O Grupo Mult é um dos maiores grupos na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.
Buscamos e valorizamos talentos, pessoas com personalidade, força de vontade e determinação.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Este banco de talentos é destinado a candidatos que desejam fazer parte do nosso time, mas ainda não encontraram uma vaga ideal. Esperamos poder direcioná-lo para alguma oportunidade em breve.

Como funciona o nosso fluxo:

  1. Quando surgir uma vaga na sua cidade, buscaremos em nosso Banco de Talentos por candidatos compatíveis com o perfil desejado.
  2. Se você atender aos requisitos, entraremos em contato através do seu e-mail para convidá-lo a participar do processo seletivo.
  3. Fique atento às notificações e ao seu e-mail.

Seguimos as determinações da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados. Portanto, só poderemos movimentar seu cadastro entre as vagas se você autorizar, no seu cadastro, o armazenamento do seu currículo por tempo indeterminado.

O cadastro no Banco de Talentos não garante uma avaliação ou oportunidade imediata. Entraremos em contato quando houver uma vaga que corresponda ao seu perfil.

História do Grupo Mult

A trajetória do Grupo Mult começou com Maxwell Lage, que em julho de 1993 abriu uma revenda de automóveis multimarcas em Governador Valadares (MG). Com o tempo, a empresa se consolidou como uma das maiores na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.

Para conhecer melhor essa evolução, confira a linha do tempo a seguir:

  1. 1993: Fundação em Governador Valadares (MG). Rápido crescimento, com filiais em Caratinga, Ipatinga e Teófilo Otoni.
  2. 2004: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Mitsubishi Motors e expandiu suas operações para outras cidades de Minas Gerais e Espírito Santo.
  3. 2012: Inauguração da Kobe Nissan, tornando-se referência nacional e recebendo a honraria Revenda Samurai.
  4. 2020: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Renault em Governador Valadares.
  5. 2021: Inauguração da Multicar Mega Store em Vitória (ES) e conquista da concessão da Royal Enfield.
  6. Hoje: Com 16 lojas, incluindo unidades Nissan, Mitsubishi, Renault, Royal Enfield e uma loja de carros esportivos, além de atuar nos setores imobiliário, de seguros e veículos por assinatura.

title: Instock Manager, Mass Vendor Relations
description:
Amazon.com.br is looking for a smart and driven Instock Manager to join our Mass Vendor Relations team in Brazil. This person will have responsibility for ensuring inventory systems and processes are meeting the needs of the business and implementing controls around these. The right candidate thrives in a high energy environment where tactical and strategic activities are expected to be driven in parallel.


The Instock Manager will own driving improvement in inventory availability, increasing inventory efficiency, selection growth and improving purchasing processes. The successful candidate possesses a track record of successful implementation and execution of inventory management practices, leveraging strong analytical acumen and working with cross-functional teams. The position requires an individual who can work autonomously in a highly demanding and often ambiguous environment, with strong attention to detail. The candidate should be able to manage multiple vendors simultaneously and make sure items are always available to our customers in Brazil. This role is located in São Paulo, Brazil.


At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. Therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we engage in and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of 'Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer.' Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that 'Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility.' Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses, and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. Besides that, they act as ambassadors of this agenda, and they will support you from Day 1. Remember, at Amazon 'It’s always Day 1.' Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.


Key job responsibilities

Inventory & Supply Chain Management:

  1. Manage the supply chain to guarantee an efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows among: forecasting, purchasing, and solving receipts problems
  2. Work with vendors to ensure a reliable and operationally effective flow of goods
  3. Deliver maximum available selection in the category
  4. Design seasonal and promotional inventory preparation plan
  5. Control budgets and deliver actions to meet inventory targets
  6. Execute action plans to reduce return/liquidation costs

Operational Efficiency:

  1. Measure and improve purchasing lead times, reduce operational defects, and improve systems to streamline operations between vendors and Amazon
  2. Perform root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and manage improvements

Project Management:

  1. Work with internal teams to drive system, tools and process improvements/implementation that affect purchasing and vendor management workflow, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually
  2. Develop analysis of key business metrics, with emphasis on developing and executing recommendations for improvement
  3. Lead projects from initial development to implementation that will streamline supply systems and processes and drive operational improvements.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Advanced English Proficiency
- Experience in product/category management or commercial planning.
- Experience in logistics, supply chain and/or supply management

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of the principles of statistical inventory control
- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma
- Proficiency in SQL and database concepts
